image_description: A grand, ornate Gothic-style high altar situated within a cathedral. The structure is made of light-colored stone with intricate carvings and statues. It features a central tabernacle area flanked by columns and niches containing religious figures. Above the altar are three large stained-glass windows depicting biblical scenes, framed by pointed arches. In the foreground, wooden choir stalls or pews are visible. The lighting is warm and ambient, highlighting the texture of the stone.
